RULE-1.gloss: If one glass costs p dollars, h is half of sixteen glasses, and h times p equals t, then h glasses (before discount) cost t dollars

RULE-2.gloss: Every second glass costs 60% of the original price, i.e., if h glasses cost t dollars (undiscounted) and t times 0.60 equals d, then those h glasses cost d dollars (discounted)

RULE-3.gloss: The total cost of all 16 glasses equals the cost of the first glass plus the cost of the remaining 8 discounted glasses
RULE-3.verify_reason: This rule incorrectly partitions the 16 glasses into only 1 full-price glass + 8 discounted glasses (9 total), ignoring the other 7 full-price glasses that must also be paid for at $5 each; it does not correctly account for all 16 glasses.

INF-1.gloss: The 8 glasses (undiscounted) cost $40, from FACT-1, FACT-2, FACT-3, RULE-1 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-2.gloss: The 8 glasses (discounted) cost $24, from INF-1, FACT-4, RULE-2 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-3.gloss: The total cost of all 16 glasses is $29, from FACT-1, INF-2, FACT-5, RULE-3 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

errors.message: This rule incorrectly partitions the 16 glasses into only 1 full-price glass + 8 discounted glasses (9 total), ignoring the other 7 full-price glasses that must also be paid for at $5 each; it does not correctly account for all 16 glasses.
